name: Small
blurb: A lean, fast mission. Tight budget, tiny mass — every kilogram is a fight.
inspiredBy: NASA small planetary missions such as SIMPLEx (e.g. Lunar Trailblazer) and Lunar Prospector
notes: Game value. Raised from $175M so that a three-instrument lunar orbiter (the three-star route in Lunar Ice Prospector) fits under the cap.
